when:
has(event.row.before) && event.row.before != null
&& ("effective_range" in event.row.before
||"exit_ground" in event.row.before
||"exit_facts" in event.row.before)
effect:
movements.filter(
  m,
  m.reference != null
  &&m.reference.startsWith("exit:" + event.row.id + ":")
  &&!((event.row.exit_facts != null
  &&event.row.effective_range.to != null
    ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
    + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
      ?event.row.exit_ground
      :"")
    :"")
  !=""
  &&m.reference.endsWith(
    ":"
    + (event.row.exit_facts != null
    &&event.row.effective_range.to != null
      ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
      + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
        ?event.row.exit_ground
        :"")
      :""
  ) )
) ).map(
  m,
  {
    "collection": "leave_catalog_entry",
    "operation": "delete",
    "data": {"target": [m.id]}
  }
)
+tasks.filter(
  t,
  t.facts != null && has(t.facts.exit_key)
  &&t.facts.exit_key
  != (event.row.exit_facts != null
  &&event.row.effective_range.to != null
    ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
    + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
      ?event.row.exit_ground
      :"")
    :""
) ).map(
  t,
  {
    "collection": "regulatory_task",
    "operation": "update",
    "data": {
      "target": [t.id],
      "set": {
        "state": "DISMISSED",
        "dismiss_reason": "The exit it answered was changed on "
        +event.day
        +".",
        "occurrence_key": t.occurrence_key + ":withdrawn:" + event.day
      }
    }
  }
)
+exit_pay.filter(
  e,
  e.facts != null && has(e.facts.source)
  &&string(e.facts.source).startsWith("exit:" + event.row.id + ":")
  &&!((event.row.effective_range.to != null
  &&has(event.row.exit_ground)
  &&event.row.exit_ground != null
  &&event.row.exit_ground != ""
    ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/" + event.row.exit_ground
    :"")
  !=""
  &&string(e.facts.source).endsWith(
    ":"
    + (event.row.effective_range.to != null
    &&has(event.row.exit_ground)
    &&event.row.exit_ground != null
    &&event.row.exit_ground != ""
      ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
      +event.row.exit_ground
      :""
  ) )
) ).map(
  e,
  {
    "collection": "adhoc_catalog_entry",
    "operation": "delete",
    "data": {"target": [e.id]}
  }
)

catalogues.filter(
  c,
  has(c.entitlement) && c.entitlement != null && has(c.entitlement.days)
  &&!movements.exists(
    m,
    m.reference
    =="exit:" + event.row.id + ":" + c.code + ":"
    +string(event.row.effective_range.to)
    +"/"
    + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
      ?event.row.exit_ground
      :""
  ) )
).map(
  c,
  {
    "collection": "leave_catalog_entry",
    "operation": "create",
    "data": {
      "catalog_id": c.id,
      "employment_id": event.row.id,
      "occurred_on": event.row.effective_range.to,
      "activity": "ENCASHMENT",
      "reference": "exit:" + event.row.id + ":" + c.code + ":"
      +string(event.row.effective_range.to)
      +"/"
      + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
        ?event.row.exit_ground
        :""),
      "days": max(
        0.0,
        sum(
          event.leave_balances.filter(b, b.code == c.code).map(
            b,
            b.remaining
          )
        )
      )
    }
  }
).filter(
  w,
  w.data.days > 0
)

name: Social insurance monthly declaration and payment

definition.description: Declare and pay the month's social insurance with the employee shares withheld. Due: SH by the 15th of the contribution month, KM by the 20th.

name: Housing provident fund monthly remittance

references.title: 住房公积金管理条例 第十九条第一款: 职工个人缴存的住房公积金, 由所在单位每月从其工资中代扣代缴; 单位应当于每月发放职工工资之日起5日内将单位缴存的和为职工代缴的住房公积金汇缴到住房公积金专户内.

definition.description: Remit the housing provident fund within 5 days of the wage day (the run's pay day; the period end when the run has none).

name: IIT withholding declaration and payment

references.title: 个人所得税法 第十四条第一款 (次月十五日内缴入国库并报送扣缴申报表); 个人所得税扣缴申报管理办法(试行) 第六条 (按月预扣, 所属期为支付月份); 税收征收管理法实施细则 第一百零九条 (期限的最后一日是法定休假日的, 以休假日期满的次日为期限的最后一日; 在期限内有连续3日以上法定休假日的, 按休假日天数顺延); 国家税务总局办公厅《关于明确2026年度申报纳税期限的通知》(税总办征科函〔2025〕64号).

definition.description: File the withholding return and pay the IIT withheld. The period is the month the wages are paid (run pay day, else the period end); due by the 15th of the next month as extended by the national filing calendar (2026: 20 Jan, 24 Feb, 16 Mar, 20 Apr, 22 May, 15 Jun, 15 Jul, 17 Aug, 15 Sep, 26 Oct, 16 Nov, 15 Dec).

name: Union fund monthly remittance

references.title: 上海市工会条例 (2002年修正) 第四十一条: 建立工会的企业、事业单位、机关应当于每月十五日前按照上月全部职工工资总额的百分之二向工会拨缴当月的工会经费; 成立工会筹备组织的, 自成立工会筹备组织之日起按前款规定拨缴 https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw5652/20200905/0001-5652_362.html. 云南省实施《中华人民共和国工会法》办法 (2022年11月30日修订) 第二十七条: 建立工会组织的用人单位按月依照上月全部职工工资总额的百分之二向工会拨缴经费 https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/sssjrdcwhdsswuchy_1130/19708.html. Owner ruling (2026-10-07, binding): the Kunming union fund stays a monthly remittance; paying monthly is never late against the quarterly collection windows (4/7/10/12月 1-15日) that the secondary copies of 云工通〔2021〕1号 state.

definition.description: Remit the union fund (2% of the previous month's total wages) on the city's day: the day it names in the next month, else the next month's end.

name: Union preparatory fund quarterly declaration (Kunming, no union)

references.title: 云南省总工会关于税务机关代收工会经费和建会筹备金有关事项的通知 (云工通〔2021〕1号) 一: 缴费单位应于季度终了后次月15日内到主管税务机关申报缴纳工会经费和建会筹备金, 第一征期4月1日—15日, 第二征期7月1日—15日, 第三征期10月1日—15日, 第四征期提前至每年12月1日—15日 https://www.ynjc.gov.cn/jcqzfxxgk/zhxx2708/20210709/1268119.html (Read 2026-10-08); 国家税务总局云南省税务局关于切换工会经费和建会筹备金征收渠道的通告 (2021年8月26日): 在每年固定的四个征期内申报缴纳, 非征期内不再受理申报 https://www.hhlx.gov.cn/info/3201/277421.htm (Read 2026-10-08); 中国工会章程 第三十八条第二款 (2%). A unit with a union stays on the monthly UNION_FUND_REMITTANCE (owner ruling 2026-10-07).

definition.description: A Kunming unit without a union declares and pays the 2% preparatory fund to the tax bureau in the collection period after the quarter: 1–15 April, July and October; the fourth quarter by 15 December.

name: Disabled persons' employment security fund

references.title: 残疾人就业保障金征收使用管理办法 (财税〔2015〕72号) 第八条、第九条; 残疾人就业保障金征收使用管理办法 (财税〔2015〕72号) 第八条、第九条; 财政部公告2023年第98号 (至2027年12月31日: 1%以上按50%, 1%以下按90%; 30人以下暂免); 云南省 残疾人按比例就业 联网认证 and 申报缴纳.

definition.description: (prior-year average headcount × 1.5% − disabled employees) × the prior-year average wage, capped at 2× the local average; 50% where the disabled ratio is at least 1%, 90% under it (to 2027-12-31); none at 30 or fewer employees. Entity facts: prior_year_average_headcount, prior_year_disabled_employees, prior_year_average_wage, local_average_annual_wage.

name: Annual income and withholding statement to employees

references.title: 国家税务总局《个人所得税扣缴申报管理办法(试行)》(公告2018年第61号) 第十三条: 支付工资、薪金所得的扣缴义务人应当于年度终了后两个月内, 向纳税人提供其个人所得和已扣缴税款等信息.

definition.description: Give each employee their prior-year wage income and the tax withheld. Raised on the January run; due by the end of February.

name: IIT annual reconciliation (综合所得汇算清缴)

references.title: 个人所得税法 第十一条第一款: 居民个人取得综合所得, 按年计算个人所得税; 有扣缴义务人的, 由扣缴义务人按月或者按次预扣预缴税款; 需要办理汇算清缴的, 应当在取得所得的次年三月一日至六月三十日内办理汇算清缴; 第十二条. 国家税务总局《个人所得税综合所得汇算清缴管理办法》(国家税务总局令第57号, 2025年2月26日施行) 第五条 (三月一日至六月三十日), 第十四条第二项 (单位代为办理须经纳税人确认, 未确认的单位不得代为办理), 第十六条 (资料留存5年).

definition.description: Annual reconciliation of the prior year's comprehensive income from 1 March to 30 June; the employer files it for the employees who entrust it to them. Raised on the March run; due 30 June.

name: Social insurance registration of a new employee

references.title: 社会保险法 第五十八条第一款: 用人单位应当自用工之日起三十日内为其职工向社会保险经办机构申请办理社会保险登记.

name: Housing provident fund deposit registration

references.title: 住房公积金管理条例 第十五条第一款: 单位录用职工的, 应当自录用之日起30日内向住房公积金管理中心办理缴存登记, 并办理职工住房公积金账户的设立或者转移手续.

name: Employee roster entry (职工名册)

references.title: 劳动合同法 第七条: 用人单位自用工之日起即与劳动者建立劳动关系; 用人单位应当建立职工名册备查; 劳动合同法实施条例 第八条 (名册内容).

name: Termination certificate

references.title: 劳动合同法 第五十条第一款: 用人单位应当在解除或者终止劳动合同时出具解除或者终止劳动合同的证明; 劳动合同法实施条例 第二十四条 (证明内容).

name: Economic compensation payment

definition.description: Pay the economic compensation on the grounds 第四十六条 makes it owing: the employer proposing a mutual termination (MUTUAL_EMPLOYER_PROPOSED), 第三十八条 employer default, 第四十条 incapacity, 第四十一条 layoff, bankruptcy or closure (第四十四条第四、五项), and fixed-term expiry unless the employee refused renewal on equal or better terms (`exit_facts.employee_refused_renewal_on_equal_terms`). name: Foreign employee work permit and work-type residence permit

definition.description: Obtain the work permit and work-type residence permit before a foreign national (nationality other than CN; Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan residents no longer need one) starts work. Due: before the start of employment.

name: Economic layoff: explanation to the union or all staff and report to the labour authority

name: Thirty days' written notice (or a month's wage) for a 第四十条 termination

name: Employment registration of a new hire

definition.description: Register the end of the employment with the public employment service. Due: within 15 days of termination.

name: Employer social insurance registration

definition.description: Register the new employer for social insurance. Due: within 30 days of its establishment (`established_on`).

name: Employer social insurance change registration

references.title: 社会保险法 第五十七条第二款: 用人单位的社会保险登记事项发生变更或者用人单位依法终止的, 应当自变更或者终止之日起三十日内, 到社会保险经办机构办理变更或者注销社会保险登记.

definition.description: Register a change of the employer's registered particulars (its name) with social insurance within 30 days.

name: Employer housing provident fund registration

references.title: 住房公积金管理条例 第十四条第一款: 新设立的单位应当自设立之日起30日内向住房公积金管理中心办理住房公积金缴存登记, 并自登记之日起20日内, 为本单位职工办理住房公积金账户设立手续.

definition.description: Register the new employer with the housing provident fund centre and open its account. Due: within 30 days of its establishment.

name: No written labour contract one month after hire (double wages)

references.title: 劳动合同法 第十条第二款 (自用工之日起一个月内订立书面劳动合同); 第八十二条第一款: 用人单位自用工之日起超过一个月不满一年未与劳动者订立书面劳动合同的, 应当向劳动者每月支付二倍的工资; 劳动合同法实施条例 第六条.

definition.description: One month after the start of employment no written contract is recorded on the terms (`facts.written_contract_signed_on`): conclude it now; from the second month the employer owes the employee twice the wage each month until it is signed (at most 11 months). Raised by the daily tick on that day.
definition.when:
contract != null && hired_on != null && today == add_months(hired_on, 1)
&&!(has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms)
&&contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(
  t,
  has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.written_contract_signed_on)
))

name: No written contract after one year: deemed open-ended

references.title: 劳动合同法 第十四条第三款: 用人单位自用工之日起满一年不与劳动者订立书面劳动合同的, 视为用人单位与劳动者已订立无固定期限劳动合同; 劳动合同法实施条例 第七条.

definition.description: A full year after the start of employment no written contract is recorded: the employment is deemed an open-ended contract and a written one must be concluded at once. Raised by the daily tick on the anniversary.
definition.when:
contract != null && hired_on != null && today == add_years(hired_on, 1)
&&!(has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms)
&&contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(
  t,
  has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.written_contract_signed_on)
))

name: Payslip to each employee

references.title: 工资支付暂行规定 第六条第三款: 用人单位在支付工资时应向劳动者提供一份其个人的工资清单; 昆明市工资支付条例 第十二条; 上海市企业工资支付办法 第五条.

definition.description: Give each employee a written statement of the wage paid (items, deductions, amount) with the payment.

name: Wage payment records kept

references.title: 工资支付暂行规定 第六条第二款: 书面记录支付劳动者工资的数额、时间、领取者的姓名以及签字, 并保存两年以上备查; 保障农民工工资支付条例 (国务院令第724号) 第十五条: 工资支付台账应当至少保存3年.

definition.description: Keep the wage payment record (amounts, dates, names and signatures) for inspection: at least 2 years, 3 years for the wage ledger where the employer employs migrant workers (`employs_migrant_workers`).

name: Notify the union before a unilateral termination

references.title: 劳动合同法 第四十三条: 用人单位单方解除劳动合同, 应当事先将理由通知工会; 用人单位违反法律、行政法规规定或者劳动合同约定的, 工会有权要求用人单位纠正.

definition.description: Before terminating unilaterally (第三十九条 fault dismissal, 第四十条 incapacity), notify the union of the reasons and consider its opinion.

name: Housing provident fund annual base adjustment

references.title: 住房公积金管理条例 第十六条: 职工住房公积金的月缴存额为职工本人上一年度月平均工资乘以职工住房公积金缴存比例; 上海 2026年度 基数调整自2026年7月开始 (沪公积金 2026年度通知); 昆明 缴存年度为1月1日至12月31日 (昆明市住房公积金管理中心 2026-01-04 通告).

definition.description: Adjust each employee's housing provident fund base once a year to the prior year's monthly average wage, before that month's remittance: Shanghai from 1 July, Kunming from 1 January.
definition.due:
add_days((
  row != null && has(row.pay_date) && row.pay_date != null
  &&row.pay_date != ""
    ?string(row.pay_date)
    :period.to),
  5
)

name: Special-deduction information forms kept 5 years

references.title: 个人所得税专项附加扣除操作办法（试行）(国家税务总局公告2022年第7号) 第二十四条: 纳税人报送给扣缴义务人的《扣除信息表》, 扣缴义务人应当自预扣预缴年度的次年起留存五年.

definition.description: Keep the employees' special-additional-deduction information forms (扣除信息表) for the previous year for five years from the following year. Raised on the January run.

name: Reconciliation records kept 5 years

references.title: 个人所得税综合所得汇算清缴管理办法 (国家税务总局令第57号) 第十四条第二项 (单位代为办理须经纳税人确认), 第十六条第三款 (信息资料自汇算清缴期结束之日起留存5年)

definition.description: Where the employer filed the annual reconciliation for employees who confirmed it, keep the income, deduction and relief records for five years from the end of the reconciliation period (30 June). Raised on the June run.

name: Disabled persons' employment security fund declaration

references.title: 残疾人就业保障金征收使用管理办法 (财税〔2015〕72号) 第八条、第九条 (比例1.5%); 财政部《关于延续实施残疾人就业保障金优惠政策的公告》(财政部公告2023年第98号: 至2027年12月31日, 安排比例1%以上按50%缴纳, 1%以下按90%缴纳; 在职职工总数30人以下的企业暂免); 上海市残疾人就业保障金征收使用管理实施办法; 国家税务总局上海市税务局《2025年度残疾人就业保障金缴费指南》(申报至2026年10月31日; 工资高于社平工资2倍的按2倍) https://shanghai.chinatax.gov.cn/tax/xwdt/ztzl/zcgll/cjrbzj/jfzy/202608/t481322.html. 残疾人就业保障金征收使用管理办法 (财税〔2015〕72号); 财政部公告2023年第98号; 云南省 2025年度 残疾人按比例就业情况联网认证 3月1日至10月31日, 9月至11月申报缴纳 (个旧市人民政府通告) https://www.hhgj.gov.cn/info/6711/587781.htm.

definition.description: Declare the prior year's disabled-employee ratio and pay the fund in the city's month (`disabled_fund_month`): (prior-year average headcount × 1.5% − disabled employees) × prior-year average wage (capped at 2× the local average); at least 1% disabled pays 50%, under 1% pays 90% (to 2027-12-31); 30 or fewer employees are exempt.

name: Delete a former employee's personal information

references.title: Personal data of a former employee is kept to the end of the 10th year after the exit year — the longest retention of the records that need it: 税收征收管理法实施细则 第二十九条 (账簿、记账凭证、报表、完税凭证…其他有关涉税资料应当保存10年) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100010/c5195082/content.html. Shorter: 劳动合同法 第五十条 (contract text 2 years), 保障农民工工资支付条例 第十五条 (wage ledger 3), 专项附加扣除 records 5. The payroll vouchers are accounting archives kept 30 years from the end of their year (会计档案管理办法 第十四条, ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER_RETENTION): the payslips keep their amounts after the personal data is deleted. 个人信息保护法 第十九条 (最短时间), 第四十七条 (保存期限届满应当删除) https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-08/20/c_1631050028355286.htm.

definition.description: Once the 10-year tax-record retention has run (the end of the 10th year after the exit year), dispose of the former employee’s personal data.

name: Personal-information notice to the new employee

references.title: 个人信息保护法 第十七条、第三十条; 第十三条第一款第(二)项 (人力资源管理所必需的处理不需同意, 但告知不免除).

definition.description: Before processing a new employee's personal information, tell them who processes it, for what purpose and how, which kinds, how long it is kept, and how to exercise their rights; for sensitive information also its necessity and effect.

name: Separate consent and impact assessment for sensitive personal information

references.title: 个人信息保护法 第二十八条 (医疗健康、金融账户、不满十四周岁未成年人的个人信息为敏感个人信息), 第二十九条 (单独同意), 第五十五条第(一)项 (事前个人信息保护影响评估)

definition.description: Obtain the employee's separate consent and record a personal-information impact assessment before processing sensitive information — health data (medical certificates), bank accounts, and the data of children under 14 for the special deductions.

name: Separate consent for a medical certificate

references.title: 个人信息保护法
references.locator: 第二十八条、第二十九条

definition.description: A sick-leave or work-injury record carries health data: hold the employee's separate consent for it.

name: Notice and separate consent for an HR transfer abroad

references.title: 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (2024) 第五条第(二)项, 第十条
个人信息保护法 第三十八条、第三十九条、第五十五条第(四)项

definition.description: An entity that sends employee data to an overseas group (`transfers_hr_data_abroad`) for cross-border HR management under its labour rules is exempt from the security assessment, standard contract and certification, but must still tell the employee the recipient and purpose, obtain separate consent and record an impact assessment.
definition.when:
company != null && has(company.facts.transfers_hr_data_abroad)
&&company.facts.transfers_hr_data_abroad == true
&&row != null
&&has(row.before)
&&row.before != null
&&"facts" in row.before

name: Periodic personal-information compliance audit

references.title: 个人信息保护法 第五十四条: 个人信息处理者应当定期对其处理个人信息遵守法律、行政法规的情况进行合规审计 https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-08/20/c_1631050028355286.htm; 个人信息保护合规审计管理办法 (自2025年5月1日, 国家网信办答记者问) https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-02/14/c_1741232791991016.htm.

definition.description: Audit the entity's personal-information processing against the law; raised each December as the periodic cadence (the measures fix every two years only for processors of more than 10 million people).

name: Report the foreign employee's exit and return the permits

references.title: 外国人在中国就业管理规定 (2017年修订) 第二十条: 被聘用的外国人与用人单位的劳动合同被解除后, 该用人单位应及时报告劳动、公安部门, 交还该外国人的就业证和居留证件, 并到公安机关办理出境手续.

definition.description: When a foreign employee's labour contract ends, report to the labour and public security authorities, return the work permit and residence document, and arrange the exit formalities.

name: Register a juvenile worker and the pre-job health check

references.title: 未成年工特殊保护规定 (劳部发〔1994〕498号) 第二条, 第六条第(一)项, 第九条
劳动法
references.locator: 第五十八条、第六十五条

definition.description: A worker aged 16–17 at hire: register with the county labour authority (未成年工登记证) and have the health check before the post is assigned.
definition.applies_when:
employee != null && has(employee.date_of_birth)
&&employee.date_of_birth != null
&&employee.date_of_birth != ""
&&age_on(employee.date_of_birth, hired_on) >= 16
&&age_on(employee.date_of_birth, hired_on) < 18

name: Juvenile worker health check after a year of work

references.title: 未成年工特殊保护规定 第六条第(二)项

definition.description: A juvenile worker still under 18 on the first anniversary of hire: the health check after one year of work.
definition.when:
today == add_years(hired_on, 1) && employee != null
&&employee.date_of_birth != null
&&employee.date_of_birth != ""
&&age_on(employee.date_of_birth, today) < 18

name: Open-ended contract on the employee's request after 10 years

references.title: 劳动合同法 第十四条第二款第(一)项

definition.description: Ten years of continuous service on a fixed-term contract: if the employee asks for or agrees to a renewal, conclude an open-ended contract unless they ask for a fixed term. A reminder on the anniversary; the OPEN_ENDED_REQUIRED validation refuses a fixed-term renewal after 10 years or two consecutive fixed terms.

name: Social insurance paid late: the 0.05% daily surcharge

references.title: 社会保险法 第八十六条: 自欠缴之日起, 按日加收万分之五的滞纳金; 社会保险费征缴暂行条例 第二十条.

definition.description: The social insurance remittance was settled after its due day: pay the surcharge of 0.05% of the amount for each day from the due day; it may not be charged to employees.

name: Keep the year's payroll vouchers 30 years

references.title: 会计档案管理办法 (财政部 国家档案局令第79号) 第十四条 and 附表 (会计凭证 30年)

definition.description: The payroll sheets and vouchers of the accounting year are kept 30 years from its end (accounting archive, outside the personal-data retention).

effect:
calendar.exists(c, has(c.rules.holidays))
  ?first(calendar).rules.holidays.filter(
    h,
    (!has(h.regions) || event.row.region in h.regions)
    &&!held.exists(x, x.date == h.date)
  ).map(
    h,
    {
      "collection": "holiday",
      "operation": "create",
      "data": {
        "company_id": event.company_id,
        "date": h.date,
        "name": h.name,
        "kind": has(h.kind) ? h.kind : "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY",
        "replaces": has(h.replaces) ? h.replaces : null,
        "given_to": has(h.given_to) ? h.given_to : "EVERYONE"
      }
    }
  )
  :[]

name: Every obligation row's program
effect:
[
  {
    "code": behaviour.code,
    "name": behaviour.name,
    "references": behaviour.references,
    "rules": behaviour.definition
  }
].filter(
  d,
  (!has(d.rules.months)
  ||d.rules.months.exists(m, event.period.key.endsWith("-" + m)))
  && (!has(d.rules.applies_when)
  ||configured_eval(
    d.rules.applies_when,
    {
      "period": event.period,
      "rules": event.rules,
      "company": first(company),
      "run": run,
      "holidays": holidays.map(h, h.date),
      "holidays_named": holidays.filter(
        h,
        h.date >= event.day && h.date <= add_months(event.day, 12)
      ).map(
        h,
        {
          "date": h.date,
          "name": has(h.name) ? h.name : "",
          "kind": h.kind
        }
      )
    }
  )
  ==true)
  &&!raised.exists(o, o.duty_code == d.code)
).map(
  d,
  {
    "collection": "obligation",
    "operation": "create",
    "data": {
      "duty_code": d.code,
      "references": d.references,
      "company_id": event.company_id,
      "settings_id": event.settings_id,
      "trigger_ref": event.row.id,
      "triggered_on": event.day,
      "due_on": configured_eval(
        d.rules.due,
        {
          "period": event.period,
          "rules": event.rules,
          "company": first(company),
          "run": run,
          "holidays": holidays.map(h, h.date),
          "holidays_named": holidays.filter(
            h,
            h.date >= event.day && h.date <= add_months(event.day, 12)
          ).map(
            h,
            {
              "date": h.date,
              "name": has(h.name) ? h.name : "",
              "kind": h.kind
            }
          )
        }
      ),
      "amount_due": has(d.rules.amount)
        ?configured_eval(
          d.rules.amount,
          {
            "rules": event.rules,
            "total": sum(
              d.rules.schemes.map(
                s,
                s in run.totals.schemes
                  ?run.totals.schemes[s].employee
                  +run.totals.schemes[s].employer
                  :0.0
              )
            ),
            "run": run,
            "period": event.period,
            "company": first(company),
            "headcount_months": event.headcount_months
          }
        )
        :round(
          sum(
            d.rules.schemes.map(
              s,
              s in run.totals.schemes
                ?run.totals.schemes[s].employee
                +run.totals.schemes[s].employer
                :0.0
            )
          ),
          0.01
        ),
      "occurrence_key": d.code + ":" + event.row.id
    }
  }
).filter(
  w,
  w.data.amount_due > 0.0
)

      &&event.row.exit_facts != null
      &&has(event.row.effective_range)
      &&event.row.effective_range.to != null
        ?{
          "exit_key": string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
          + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
            ?event.row.exit_ground
            :"")
        }
        :{}),
      "code": d.code,
      "title": d.name,
      "references": d.references,
      "subject_collection": event.collection,
      "subject_id": event.row.id,
      "company_id": event.company_id,
      "settings_id": event.settings_id,
      "trigger_ref": event.row.id,
      "triggered_on": event.day,
      "due_on": configured_eval(
        d.rules.due,
        {
          "row": event.row,
          "rules": event.rules,
          "period": event.period,
          "company": first(company),
          "contract": first(contract),
          "employee": first(employee),
          "hired_on": size(contract) > 0
            ?first(contract).effective_range.from
            :null,
          "exit_on": size(contract) > 0
            ?first(contract).effective_range.to
            :null,
          "holidays": holidays.map(h, h.date),
          "holidays_named": holidays.filter(
            h,
            h.date >= event.day && h.date <= add_months(event.day, 12)
          ).map(
            h,
            {
              "date": h.date,
              "name": has(h.name) ? h.name : "",
              "kind": h.kind
            }
          ),
          "today": event.day,
          "headcount": event.headcount,
          "previous_year_headcount_months": has(
            event.previous_year_headcount_months
          )
            ?event.previous_year_headcount_months
            :[],
          "separations": event.separations,
          "headcount_by_worksite": event.headcount_by_worksite,
          "headcount_permanent": event.headcount_permanent,
          "headcount_permanent_by_worksite": event.headcount_permanent_by_worksite
        }
      ),
      "occurrence_key": d.code + ":" + event.company_id + ":"
      + (has(d.rules.occurrence)
        ?string(
          configured_eval(
            d.rules.occurrence,
            {
              "row": event.row,
              "rules": event.rules,
              "period": event.period,
              "company": first(company),
              "contract": first(contract),
              "employee": first(employee),
              "hired_on": size(contract) > 0
                ?first(contract).effective_range.from
                :null,
              "exit_on": size(contract) > 0
                ?first(contract).effective_range.to
                :null,
              "holidays": holidays.map(h, h.date),
              "holidays_named": holidays.filter(
                h,
                h.date >= event.day
                &&h.date <= add_months(event.day, 12)
              ).map(
                h,
                {
                  "date": h.date,
                  "name": has(h.name) ? h.name : "",
                  "kind": h.kind
                }
              ),
              "today": event.day,
              "headcount": event.headcount,
              "previous_year_headcount_months": has(
                event.previous_year_headcount_months
              )
                ?event.previous_year_headcount_months
                :[],
              "separations": event.separations,
              "headcount_by_worksite": event.headcount_by_worksite,
              "headcount_permanent": event.headcount_permanent,
              "headcount_permanent_by_worksite": event.headcount_permanent_by_worksite
            }
          )
        )
        :has(d.rules.repeat_key)
          ?event.row.id + ":"
          +string(
            configured_eval(
              d.rules.repeat_key,
              {
                "row": event.row,
                "rules": event.rules,
                "period": event.period,
                "company": first(company),
                "contract": first(contract),
                "employee": first(employee),
                "hired_on": size(contract) > 0
                  ?first(contract).effective_range.from
                  :null,
                "exit_on": size(contract) > 0
                  ?first(contract).effective_range.to
                  :null,
                "holidays": holidays.map(h, h.date),
                "holidays_named": holidays.filter(
                  h,
                  h.date >= event.day
                  &&h.date <= add_months(event.day, 12)
                ).map(
                  h,
                  {
                    "date": h.date,
                    "name": has(h.name) ? h.name : "",
                    "kind": h.kind
                  }
                ),
                "today": event.day,
                "headcount": event.headcount,
                "previous_year_headcount_months": has(
                  event.previous_year_headcount_months
                )
                  ?event.previous_year_headcount_months
                  :[],
                "separations": event.separations,
                "headcount_by_worksite": event.headcount_by_worksite,
                "headcount_permanent": event.headcount_permanent,
                "headcount_permanent_by_worksite": event.headcount_permanent_by_worksite
              }
            )
          )
          : (event.collection == "payroll_run"
            ?event.row.period
            :event.collection == "calendar"
              ?event.row.id + ":" + event.day
              :event.row.id))
    }
  }
)
